name: function-pointer-invocation-test-79ce9f570b/function-pointer-invocation-e.bal
spec_references: Subset restrictions > Import declarations: "Only following lang libraries with given methods/types are supported"; ballerina/lang.string list omits toCodePointInts and ballerina/lang.array list omits sort.

Subset restrictions > Invocations > Other invocation restrictions: "Method call syntax can be used for calling the following langlib functions:" (neither string:toCodePointInts nor array:sort is listed).
Expressions > Query expressions: "Supports `from`, `where`, `let`, `join` (including outer join), `order by`, `limit`, `on conflict` and `select` clauses".
reason: The first asserted query uses a function value that computes string code points and sorts them. Both toCodePointInts() and sort() are excluded by the explicit langlib positive lists, so the whole case requires unsupported functionality irrespective of support for function pointers and select queries. Additional tests execute from/do query actions, which are not included in the listed query expression clauses or supported statements.
test_design_notes: io:println appears only in unused instrumentation and is not a classification basis.
The @error comments do not remove the runtime assertions from this executable case.
